headline: ALLIES LAUNCH MASSIVE SURPRISE ASSAULT AT AMIENS, GERMAN LINES BROKEN
dispatch: Allied forces struck the German front at Amiens before dawn on August 8, 1918, unleashing a coordinated assault of infantry, tanks, and aircraft that shattered four German divisions within hours. The attack, conceived by General Rawlinson and executed under Field Marshal Haig, advanced up to eight miles on the first day, the greatest single-day gain on the Western Front. German commander Ludendorff later called it the black day of the German Army.
answer: Battle of Amiens launches the Hundred Days Offensive, 1918
